sections.text_helper: Section 31.3.32 "UIF bit remapping" in chapter 31 (Advanced-control timers (TIM1/TIM8)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 1047.
sections.section_content:
The IUFREMAP bit in the TIM_CR1 register forces a continuous copy of the update interrupt
flag UIF into the timer counter register’s bit 31 (TIM_CNT[31]). This allows both the counter
value and a potential roll-over condition signaled by the UIFCPY flag to be read in an atomic
way. In particular cases, it can ease the calculations by avoiding race conditions, caused for
instance by a processing shared between a background task (counter reading) and an
interrupt (update interrupt).
There is no latency between the UIF and UIFCPY flags assertion.
